name: India Homes Limited
about: India Homes Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of stainless-steel and allied products primarily in India. Its product portfolio includes hot rolled products, including wire rods, round bars, cast billets, rolled billets, and cut billets; bright bar products; and wires. The company was formerly known as India Steel Works Limited and changed its name to India Homes Limited in September 2025. India Steel Works Limited was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
